attestations.text: Tao Hui 小刀會 or Small Sword Society, and included adherents of the Triad or T'ien Ti Hui 天地會, an old secret society which aimed at the overthrow of the Manchu dynasty. The leader of the Sword society was a native of Kuangtung, named Liu Li-ch'uan 劉麗川, who for a time was interpreter to Western merchants and later gained popularity at Shanghai as a physician treating the poor without charge.
